mechanism: Lock one subject's face, core proportions, frontal orientation and camera axis in a stable portrait. Use one consistent transition gate to replace at least two coordinated style channels per stage—environment, wardrobe, material, props or light—while preserving the identity anchors. Escalate through visibly different worlds, then use the same gate to return to the exact opening world and portrait relationship.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable portrait with face, body proportions, orientation and camera axis readable before the first switch.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate montage gives no stable comparison state.

invariants.rule: Use one repeatable transition gate while preserving the subject's facial identity and registration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated cuts can hide identity drift.

invariants.rule: Change at least two coordinated style channels in each new world.
invariants.purpose: Proves full world replacement rather than recoloring.
invariants.ablation_failure: A palette swap alone is not a world carousel.

invariants.rule: Pass through at least three materially different worlds while retaining the same identity anchors.
Return through the same gate to the opening world and portrait relationship.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new final glamour portrait cannot verify the baseline.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source young woman in a black office suit
the source cat-ear event styling, armored battlefield, underwater goggles, pastoral cloak and red carpet
the source cool white office and paparazzi crowd
the source exact world order, frontal fashion portrait staging and Hailuo/MiniMax marks

instantiations.concept: An original translucent jellyfish navigator floats frontally inside a white calibration tank, identified by one crescent bell notch and three amber tendrils. A circular caustic flare carries it through a volcanic archive, a cyan ice library, a moss observatory and a black velvet signal chamber, changing environment and accessories while the notch, tendrils and scale stay fixed before returning to the white tank.

instantiations.concept: In tactile paper stop motion, one masked courier puppet is locked to a front-facing registration stand. A folding iris moves it through a red print shop, silver lunar depot, green rain shelter and blue acoustic theatre; paper costume layers and props change in pairs while one split mask and triangular badge persist, then the iris returns to the plain stand.
